description: We are a trio of 11th graders interested in tech and the cosmos.
summary:
Developed by The Team Footprints Across The Cosmos, is an interactive platform designed to make planetary exploration easier to understand and explore. Instead of presenting space missions through long lists of facts, our project allows users to discover them through an engaging visual experience.

Users can interact with 3D models of Mars and the Moon, explore their surfaces through detailed maps, and discover important landing locations. By selecting a landing site or mission, users can learn about it's important information

The platform brings together missions from different generations, including historic Apollo and Surveyor missions, as well as India's Chandrayaan programme. It highlights how each mission has helped scientists understand the surfaces, environments, and history of these celestial bodies.

We are also incorporating orbital mission exploration, allowing users to learn about spacecraft that study planets from space without landing on them. The aim is to connect mission information with its actual location and purpose, making exploration more meaningful.

Our goal is to turn complex space mission data into an accessible and interactive learning experience, helping students and space enthusiasts appreciate humanity's journey beyond Earth and inspiring curiosity about future exploration.
details: This project allows offers user a friendly and simple way to explore several lander and orbital missions sent to Moon and Mars by NASA and ISRO. The project comprises of 3D models of mars and moon which the user can spin around and explore various sites
